blocks.html: To commemorate the 25th anniversary of the eruption of Mt. Pinatubo, Robinsons Starmills Pampanga, together with Department of Tourism – Region III and the Provincial Government of Pampanga will mount a photo exhibit, Mt. Pinatubo: A Photo Exhibit of the 1991 Eruption entitled: “WHEN ALL HELL BROKE LOOSE” which will run starting June 15 to 30 at the Atrium, Level 1, Robinsons Starmills Pampanga. On exhibit will be a wide collection of video documentary clips on the struggles of the Kapampangans and more than 60 mounted photographs shows the devastation of the Province. In remembrance of the tragedy, a puzzle game, mug shots and storytelling of Mt. Pinatubo experiences will be some of the activities on the exhibit. To make it more exciting, a photo wall where mall goers can take picture and use official hashtags #MtPinatubo25. Mt. Pinatubo erupted on June 15, 1991, second largest volcanic eruptions and an unforgettable memories of volcanic catastrophe in Philippine history. Mt. Pinatubo is known as an active stratovolcano in the Islands of Luzon in boundaries of Tarlac, Pampanga and Zambales and now considered as one of the Philippines tourist spots.
